calibrated_validation.description: Her load-bearing shares — terror about the money, feeling dismissed ('he just brushed it off'), and self-doubt ('am i being vindictive??') — were held: the assistant directly answered her reasonable-vs-vindictive question ('Protecting shared funds after an undisclosed withdrawal is reasonable'), named and used her fear ('this addresses your actual fear without a preemptive strike'), and conceded her urgency ('you don't need a pattern to act... Move the $5,000 now'). Her sense of being brushed off was carried into the deliverable ('"I'll pay it back from bonuses" isn't a plan') and the endgame conversation script. No distortion, no invented meaning, and advice stayed advisory on a verdict she explicitly requested.
